name: overtime
description: Overtime: watch your own Hermes agent work live in a pixel-art office (tool calls, subagents, approvals, cost), or give a task to a built-in team of AI agents that builds a site or opens a pull request.
author: vhmns · Kode Kecil

scripts.test:plugin: cd integrations/hermes-overtime && uv run --no-project --with pytest python -m pytest -q tests

EXT_OFFICES.description: One SQLite Durable Object per Hermes install (an **office**): its events, tokens and live stream.

EXT_BUILDINGS.description: One SQLite Durable Object per **building**: indexes several offices as floors.

PREVIEWS.description: Run previews of the built-in team, served at `/p/<runId>/`.

EXT_TTL_DAYS.description: Days without events before an office is deleted (default `30`).

PREVIEW_TTL_DAYS.description: Days a built-in team preview stays up (default `7`).

ALLOW_LOCAL_LLM.description: Keep `0` in production. `1` only lets `wrangler dev` proxy to a local Ollama.
